title: DATA, NOT NOISE // FLIGHT DECK
style: Vibe: Mid‑tempo, industrial electronic, spoken word vs robotic counter‑voice, similar pacing to your first track.
lyrics:
[Intro – female vocoder, low, panned wide]
Scanning again.
Same chain, new regime.
Pilot brain online.
Data, not dreams.

[Verse 1 – male, calm but tight pocket]
Cockpit glow, charts lit in the dark,
Tom’s reading on-chain like he’s lining up a arc.
Long-haul mindset, never rushed on the climb,
Every metric is a waypoint mapped against time.
Particle physics in a Bitcoin storm,
Filtering the noise, what’s signal, what’s norm.
While the feed sells panic in a dopamine loop,
He’s tracking UTXOs moving quietly in groups.

Capitulation whispers in the cohort’s strain,
Who’s underwater, who’s numbing their pain.
Not just candles and the fear on X,
He wants the stress curves, the flows, the context.

[Pre-Hook – robotic counter-voice]
Surface: volatile.
Structure: methodical.
Narrative: emotional.
On-chain: mechanical.

[Hook – male + female vocoder call/response]
Is it hype, or a state you can measure?
Is it fear, or compressed risk pressure?
Same price, but a different frame of mind,
Data, not noise, that’s On-Chain Mind.
If the feed shouts “crash” in a single line,
He zooms out cycles, full risk design.
No guess, no guru, no borrowed spine,
Just data, not noise, in On-Chain Mind.

[Verse 2 – male, more rhythmic]
Seven thousand thinkers in a quiet room,
Looking past the memes, asking “bust or boom?”
Custom metrics like instruments on a dash,
Ω-scores, drawdowns, long-term cash.
He’s not scripting your trade, not your PnL fate,
He’s drawing the regime, you choose your gate.
DCA patience or lump-sum strike,
He shows the profile, you decide what’s right.

Market cycles don’t bow to a thread,
They grind through time, through green and red.
He marks the fatigue where the sellers are through,
Where supply gets tight and belief renews.

[Bridge – spoken, ultra calm]
No shortcuts.
No magic line.
Just a map,
And the courage to align.

[Final Hook – group, anthemic]
Data, not noise, in the deepest drawdown,
Signal, not toys, when the crowd spins around.
If you’re done with the drama, the headline grind,
Welcome to the cockpit: On-Chain Mind.
